# Shakti Sabha (शक्ति सभा) — Union of Peace & Revolution

> Shakti Sabha is an independent, grassroots Indian initiative founded by Harshita Mankar (2019–Present) working across women's safety, self-defence training, confidential psychosocial counselling, youth leadership, Indian history and heritage, and research-driven public dialogue.

- **Website:** https://shaktisabha.com
- **Founder:** Harshita Mankar (Aaryaveera)
- **Contact:** contact@shaktisabha.com
- **Active Regions:** Maharashtra (Akola, Nagpur, Mumbai, Vidarbha), Madhya Pradesh (Betul, Bhopal, Chhindwara), Gujarat, Delhi, and institutional campuses across 28+ cities in India.

## Three Institutional Streams

1. **Mission Mardini** (`https://shaktisabha.com/mardini`)
   Physical and tactical preparedness for girls and women — self-defence foundations, Lathi-Kaushal, situational awareness, and residential training cohorts.
2. **Shakti Bhava** (`https://shaktisabha.com/shakti-bhava` | Counselling: `https://shaktisabha.com/counselling`)
   Consciousness, emotional resilience, trauma-informed listening circles, confidential counselling pathways, and referrals to qualified professionals.
3. **Shakti Varta** (`https://shaktisabha.com/shakti-varta` | Research: `https://shaktisabha.com/research`)
   Research, seminars, historical inquiry, Modi-script and civilizational heritage studies, case studies, and critical public dialogue.

## Foundational Worldview

- **Aaryaveera** (`https://shaktisabha.com/aaryaveera`): The philosophical and ideological identity of founder Harshita Mankar, uniting inner steadiness (peace) with courageous preparedness (strength): *"From strength alone arises lasting peace."*

## Verified Ground Impact (2019–Present)

- **2,000+** girls and young women trained through practical self-defence and preparedness cohorts
- **25,000+** young people reached across 500+ educational and institutional sessions
- **250+** psychosocial support situations and **13** documented rescue interventions
